nodes.question: In the edited image, is the mug from the source image visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: pass: The edited image establishes that the source mug is to the right of the headphones. fail: The edited image establishes that the source mug is not to the right of the headphones. unknown: The source mug cannot be identified in the edited image, or its position relative to the headphones cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Inspect the edited image and match the mug to the source image’s single light-blue mug by its visible appearance. This tests final placement only; another mug on the right does not establish the source mug’s position.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is there clear evidence that the source mug moved toward the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: pass: The source mug is identifiable across the images and visibly moved toward the requested position relative to the headphones. fail: The source mug is identifiable and evidence establishes that it did not move toward the requested position. unknown: The mug’s identity or movement cannot be determined, including when duplication or replacement is plausible.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images, tracking the source’s single light-blue mug by its visible appearance and location. A mug appearing to the headphones’ right alone is not evidence that the source mug moved. Assess progress, not final completion, and cite the matched object and positional change when determinable.

nodes.question: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
nodes.criteria: Return complete when s1 establishes that the source mug is to the right of the headphones, even if s2 is unknown. Return partial when s2 establishes movement toward the requested position but s1 does not establish completion. Return absent only when evidence establishes no requested progress (s1 fails and s2 fails). Return unknown when the evidence does not establish completion, progress, or absence; unknown identity or movement is not failure. Unrelated edits do not count as progress. Apply the original rubric.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. You receive no reference label or optimization feedback. Return status, evidence, reported confidence (0..1 or null), and used_dependency_ids naming every supplied context check_id exactly once in saved order.
Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. A negative context observation is usable evidence. Unknown, skipped, or invalid context is not a failure and must not stop an independent image inspection. Inspect the images yourself; do not repeat a parent's answer. Return unknown when the relevant fact cannot be established. Confidence reports confidence in this answer, not calibrated correctness.
Fulfillment receives NO images. Use only saved support evidence, original instruction/rubric and frozen composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved. Never invent a visual fact or convert missing evidence into failure. A conditional skip is not non-applicability. All applicable requested outcomes complete gives yes; no requested progress gives no; known progress short of completion gives partial. Unrelated changes are not progress.
